summary: Papa (bsingh) simplified UI verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (375x800). All 8 acceptance criteria pass: Papa login succeeds, sidebar renders Hindi/Hinglish labels in exact order (Ghar, Maal Bheja, Bill, Hisaab, Saman Yatra), 'More' is hidden, profile shows 'B Singh Ji' with role 'PAPA' (uppercased via CSS text-transform on 'papa'), tapping Maal Bheja navigates to /shipments with only Singh Exports data (5 shipments shown), delete-btn is NOT present on shipment detail for Papa while modify-shipment-btn + packing-list-btn are still visible. Admin (kishan) login restores English labels (Overview, Shipments, Invoices, Ledger, Trips, More), delete-btn reappears on shipment detail, and CompanySwitcher is visible in the sidebar. No new console errors introduced by this iteration — only the pre-existing P2 warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/useNativeDriver deprecation, one 'Invalid style property of background' log) that were already flagged by main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: sidebar.tsx line 325: testID uses `item.label.toLowerCase()` so Papa's testIDs contain spaces (e.g. 'sidebar-nav-maal bheja'). Works today but consider snake_case or the original English key to keep testIDs stable regardless of label overrides — otherwise any future label tweak silently breaks tests.

usePapaMode() correctly gates the destructive delete button in shipment/[id].tsx (line 405 !isPapa check). Confirmed removed from DOM for Papa and present for Admin — backend also enforces role per the agent note, so defence in depth is intact.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded users (bsingh / kishan) and existing shipments in Singh Exports scope (5 rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Papa role UX polish is verified. Nav testIDs contain spaces because they are derived from lowercased labels ('sidebar-nav-maal bheja', 'sidebar-nav-saman yatra'). Sign-in page uses testIDs signin-username, signin-password and the primary CTA has text 'LOG IN & OPEN DASHBOARD'. Storage clear + reload works to switch users when no explicit logout testID is exposed.
